name: Bin Card Report
sql_query:
SELECT
    combined.transaction_date,
    combined.trans_no,
    combined.movement_type,
    combined.store_name,
    combined.batch_no,
    combined.qty_in,
    combined.qty_out,
    combined.running_balance
FROM (
    -- 1. Opening Balance Row (Calculated from all movements prior to :from date)
    SELECT
        0                                                   AS sort_order,
        CAST(:from AS DATE)                                 AS transaction_date,
        'OPENING'                                           AS trans_no,
        'Opening Balance B/F'                               AS movement_type,
        'All / Selected Store'                              AS store_name,
        '-'                                                 AS batch_no,
        0                                                   AS qty_in,
        0                                                   AS qty_out,
        COALESCE(SUM(m.qun_in - m.qun_out), 0)             AS running_balance
    FROM t_item_movements m
    WHERE m.BC = :bc
      AND m.item_code = :item_code
      AND (:store_id IS NULL OR m.store_id = :store_id)
      AND :from IS NOT NULL
      AND m.dDate < :from
    HAVING :from IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 2. Chronological Movements with Running Balance
    SELECT
        1                                                   AS sort_order,
        t.dDate                                             AS transaction_date,
        t.trans_no,
        t.movement_type,
        t.store_name,
        COALESCE(t.batch_no, '-')                           AS batch_no,
        t.qty_in,
        t.qty_out,
        t.running_balance
    FROM (
        SELECT
            m.id,
            m.dDate,
            m.trans_no,
            CASE m.trans_code
                WHEN 'OPS'     THEN 'Opening stock'
                WHEN 'GRN'     THEN 'Goods received (Purchase)'
                WHEN 'TRF-IN'  THEN 'Transfer in'
                WHEN 'TRF-OUT' THEN 'Transfer out'
                WHEN 'INV'     THEN 'Sales invoice'
                WHEN 'SAL-RET' THEN 'Sales return'
                WHEN 'HP-SALE' THEN 'Hire purchase issue'
                WHEN 'HP-RET'  THEN 'Hire purchase return'
                WHEN 'ADJ'     THEN 'Stock adjustment'
                ELSE m.trans_code
            END AS movement_type,
            s.name AS store_name,
            m.batch_no,
            m.qun_in AS qty_in,
            m.qun_out AS qty_out,
            SUM(m.qun_in - m.qun_out) OVER (
                ORDER BY m.dDate ASC, m.id ASC
            ) AS running_balance
        FROM t_item_movements m
        JOIN stores s ON s.id = m.store_id AND s.BC = m.BC
        WHERE m.BC = :bc
          AND m.item_code = :item_code
          AND (:store_id IS NULL OR m.store_id = :store_id)
          AND (:to IS NULL OR m.dDate <= :to)
    ) t
    WHERE (:from IS NULL OR t.dDate >= :from)
) combined
ORDER BY combined.sort_order ASC, combined.transaction_date ASC, combined.trans_no ASC;
